answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 3595 Country: Pakistan Title: Is smoking allowedin islam or is it prohibitted? ALLAH sy sachay dil sy toba krny k liay kia kia krna chahiay? Question: Is smoking allowedin islam or is it prohibitted? ALLAH sy sachay dil sy toba krny k liay kia kia krna chahiay? Answer ID: 3595 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 526/415=B) (1) It is not allowed, it is makrooh . (2) First, one should leave the sin, feel guilty of doing it and make a solemn determination of not committing it again, then repent to Allah with true heart and seek His forgiveness. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
